content2.content: For Material Design apps, users expect a visual ripple effect when touching interactive elements. `InkWell` provides this effect.

content4.content: Wrap widgets in an `InkWell` to add a ripple. Note: `InkWell` must have a `Material` widget as an ancestor to draw the ink on.

content5.content:
Material(
  color: Colors.blue,
  child: InkWell(
    onTap: () {},
    child: Container(padding: EdgeInsets.all(20), child: Text('Ripple Button')),
  ),
)

content7.content: Similar to `InkWell` but allows the ripple to extend beyond the bounds of the widget (often used for circular icons).

content9.content: Use `InkWell` for rectangular areas and `InkResponse` for non-rectangular or unbounded ripples to adhere to Material Design guidelines.
